messages:
elaine_marketing: Quick ask — Need a small deliverable set for next week's product launch: 1) benchmark explainer graphic (social + slide) 2) webinar header + 16:9 thumbnail 3) email hero template with AB variants 4) inbound routing diagram for SDR handoff. Audience: PMs, platform engineers, and growth. Target launch date: 2026-04-01. Can design take this? Figma skeleton attached: https://figma.com/file/Abc123 (permissions open). Priority order: 1,2,3,4. Budget: ~10 design hours. Tagging: include UTM example in the email template. @sam_design @omar_growth

sam_design: On it. Quick Q: do we have final brand color for the benchmark tile? We had two variants last round. Also will this need motion (gif) or static PNGs? ETA if we start today: roughs by Tue.

omar_growth: For inbound routing diagram — want clear CTA mapping: webinar signups -> qualified MQL -> SDR queue -> Product demo. Need UTMs: utm_source=bench_launch&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=serving_wins_launch. Also add hidden 'model' param for analytics. cc @tia_prod_marketer

tia_prod_marketer: Copy for benchmark tile: 'Serving wins: 4x throughput, 2x cost savings' — does that map to tested data? we should avoid precise claims if not validated. Suggest 'up to 4x' unless legal approves.

legal_ops: Please send any benchmark numbers & test plan. We need source + date + test configuration for marketing claims. Also send logo lockup file and restricted icon list. We can do a quick review by Wed.

design-bot: Task created: DES-4321. Figma link copied. Export presets set: social tile 1200x1200 @2x, slide 1920x1080, email hero 600x200, thumbnail 1280x720. Deadline field set to 2026-03-28.

sam_design: Thanks — will start with static versions. If legal ok's numbers then we'll add GIF sparklines as a stretch. Can someone confirm the 'up to' phrasing? Also confirm CTA copy for email CTA: 'See the benchmark' vs 'Explore results'.

elaine_marketing: Use 'Explore results' pls. And confirm 'up to 4x' is acceptable until legal clears exact metric. Also include two colorways: dark and light. Include accessible alt text for images.

omar_growth: UTM snippet to paste in email templates:
```
?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=serving_wins_launch&utm_term=benchmark_tile&utm_content=variantA
```
Also recommend hidden form field: model_variant=llama-3-13b (for routing).

sam_design: :eyes: noted. I'll post roughs in #design-review by Tue noon. If anyone needs different sizes ping me.

legal_ops: We'll review numbers once you drop the test docs here. Also remind: no competitor comparisons by name.

elaine_marketing: :thumbsup: thank you. final ask — can we get a one-slide 'handoff' for SDRs summarizing what the benchmark means + 2 talking points? small, 1 slide.

tia_prod_marketer: I can draft the 2 talking points, will add to the figma note.

design-bot: Reminder: DES-4321 assigned to sam_design, due 2026-03-28 09:00 UTC.

sam_design: Cool. I'll upload first pass in Figma and share here.
